Next

The next token in the sequence. This will never be null, if there is no next token it will return an OutOfRange token. Note: When you set this, the token's previous token will be set to this token automatically.

public Token Next { get; set; }

Property Value

Token

NextNonWhitespace

The next token in the sequence. This will never be null, if there is no next token it will return an OutOfRange token. You will never get a whitespace token out of this, it skips over it. Note: When you set this, the token's previous token will be set to this token automatically.

public Token NextNonWhitespace { get; }

Property Value

Token

Prev

The previous token in the sequence. This will never be null, if there is no next token it will return an OutOfRange token. Note: When you set this, the token's next token will be set to this token automatically.
